messages:
maria: dropped a new prototype for the spend view called 'scope-swap-lite' — prototype: https://redwood.design/p/scope-swap-lite :eyes:
aj: nice start. two quick Qs: does the scope toggle persist time-range and token denom? that was ambiguous.
sam: agree. switching org->project currently flips denom to USD which breaks token-first workflows. can we persist per-user? :thinking:
kyle: a11y: legend chips in dark theme are ~3.7:1. bump bg to token-neutral-300. also add aria-label to the scope toggle — screen readers only see "button" right now.
olivia: invoice CTA currently global. prefer contextual: "Download project invoice" when project scoped, "Download org invoice" when org scoped. non-admins should see a disabled button with tooltip explaining permissions.
maria: for the scope toggle aria: ```html
<Toggle aria-label="Scope: organization or project" role="switch" />
```
aj: layout options: A) left-rail persistent token breakdown + chart on right; B) breakdown as compact card above chart. A helps side-by-side compare on desktop; B is denser on mobile. thoughts?
sam: vote A for desktop, but collapse the breakdown into a card on small widths and persist collapse state per user.
kyle: chart enhancement: inline micro-legend to switch between "tokens" and "USD". do transform client-side using cached rate per range so we don't hit backend for every toggle. ensure keyboard focus works for legend toggles.
billing-bot: FYI invoices API returns 404 for months not finalized and for non-billing-admins. UI should surface "Invoice not available yet" or "Access restricted" instead of raw 404.
maria: action items: 1) aria + contrast updates (kyle) 2) persist token denom per-user/session (sam) 3) contextual invoice CTA + disabled tooltip (olivia) 4) left-rail for desktop, collapsible card for mobile + persist state (aj) 5) client-side unit toggle + token explainer tooltip (maria) 6) map invoice 404 to friendly copy (aj + billing-bot). I'll update figma and hand off a tiny A/B by EOD.
aj: once A/B is ready we'll do a 3-person hallway test and iterate. :thumbsup:
